notes.title: The less clothes, the stronger! Story Of Eve 2 continues the journey of the young heroine!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/872c09feb68253ef6eb7b7cc3552f16d7a5c8e65.gif[/img]

[h2] About Game [/h2]

After [i]Story of Eve - A Hero's Study[/i], the succubus Kassandra persuades you to train Eve using some "unorthodox" methods. Eve, marked with lewd runes, makes a diligent effort to become stronger. However, as the training progresses, Eve seems to start... enjoying the process. How will your special training methods affect Eve? Who knows...

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/f2da870e0f0744a437d0bcde1244ef44da33a797.jpg[/img]

[h2] Game Features [/h2]
[list]
[*] The same exploration system as the original, but with enhanced maze-like features.
[*] Born from the rock, paper, scissors system, the brand-new card battles bring buckets of action-packed fun to Eve 2!
[*] Complete special missions to make Eve's clothes more sexy and increase her battle power!
[*] Your special training will turn the docile Eve into a domineering powerhouse... She might even counterattack you, so watch out!

[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/b0fbba6fed8f0e494efc677df7ac55aa1fb345be.jpg[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/64130c17bfa3372cbf5a405d59445b78b324410b.jpg[/img]

"X-Angels" is a rogue-lite card battle game. On the day you were supposed to lose your virginity, you were interrupted by a mysterious creature, who revealed that your purity is the key to defeating the corrupt Angels!

With kindom Asira left in ruins, Wolf, the prince of Asira, embarks on a journey around the world where he teams up with eight heroines and tries to stop the empire's ambition.

Join us in this action RPG where you cultivate relationships with the heroines with unique stories!

notes.title: Devlog for Version 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.0.1 Updates[/h3]
1. Fixed control overlap for gamepads

[h3]Version 1.0.2 Updates[/h3]
1. Added visual effects to equipment upgrades.
2. Fixed incorrect equipment sound effects.

[h3]Version 1.0.3 Updates[/h3]
1. Fixed some album viewing bugs
2. Fixed Eve's CG issues
3. Rebalanced some items to be a little more effective.

[h3]Version 1.0.4 Updates[/h3]
1. Reduced the overall size of the game.

[h3]Version 1.0.5 Updates[/h3]
1. Fixed damage area not changing when it should
2. Fixed multiple-overlapping sound effects in battle when clothes are destroyed
3. Fixed invincibility not activating when player is in recovery mode.
4. Fixed some issues people had with their Xbox controllers.
5. Succubus-chan's sound effect when damaged can no longer be overridden.
6. Fixed menu sync problems when upgrading equipment.

Thank you for your feedback over the past few days. Rest assured, we're still working on any and all issues in the game! If you found a bug or had an issue we still want to about it! 

Have fun!

notes.title: Devlog for Version 0.29
notes.content:
Devlog for Version 0.29

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38258701/150bb61030e973a1204101c4eca6133bc3ddd39c.jpg[/img]
1. Preparing Equipment System
2. Basic equipment will be available from the start.
3. Equipment (Panties) can be earned by beating levels.
4. Re-designing levels with the Zombie levels completed. Changes include easier progress and adjustments for the equipment system.
5. Replaced the ability to attack clothing in the background with a boss fight feature.

Players can access the Beta through the following steps:
1. Right-click the game in Library tab of your Steam client.
2. Select "Properties"
3. Navigate to "Betas" tab
4. Select "GTW_Tester" from the drop down list.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38258701/b6d6bc95d6946921bd284fc11acd90276d31c8eb.jpg[/img]

Please leave a comment in this thread if you find any issues. Thank you!
